claim: No file group on the ADR 0149 cutover manifest (.planning/07-reference/deploy/CUTOVER-MANIFEST-2026-09-28.md, 2026-09-28) is imported by a file that stays live once every legacy slot is gone: scripts/cutover_import_graph.py builds apps/web/src's import graph from src/main.tsx, drops App.tsx's edges to each group's legacy root, and exits 1 naming any group whose root keeps a live, non-test importer (mutation-tested: an import of ../../Help added to HelpNext.tsx makes it exit 1 naming help). A group whose root is already deleted is reported, not failed, so the row keeps holding after the cutover merges. It proves the import graph only; the manifest's trial deletes (tsc + vitest) were run once, on c8bbf95de + #487.

The nightly manifest's `legacy` value for every non-chrome page matches App.tsx: `page` only where a `<PageGate page="<slug>" legacy=` slot exists, `none` only where none does. The ADR 0149 trial cutover (CUTOVER-MANIFEST-2026-09-28.md §6) deleted 25 legacy slots and 3 redirect slots; with their entries left at `page`, the nightly flag-off walk would have failed every one of them after deploy (nightly.spec.ts asserts no Mudavym root for `page`), and check_nightly_manifest.py does not read `legacy`. A group the founder refuses restores its slot, which turns this row STALE until its entry goes back to `page`. Mutation-tested 2026-09-28 both ways (a `none` entry with a slot, a `page` entry without one).
verify: python3 -c "import json,re,sys; a=open('apps/web/src/App.tsx').read(); m=json.load(open('apps/web/e2e/nightly/manifest.json')); slot=lambda s: re.search(r'<PageGate\s+page=\"'+s+r'\"\s+legacy=',a) is not None; bad=[p['slug'] for p in m['pages'] if not p.get('chrome') and ((p['legacy']=='page' and not slot(p['slug'])) or (p['legacy']=='none' and slot(p['slug'])))]; print(bad) if bad else None; sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)"
